# grouper_folder (Data Source)

Looks up a Grouper folder by its full name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "grouper_folder" "apps" {
  name = "org:dept:apps"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Current full name of the folder, with segments separated by colons, such as `org:dept:apps`. Grouper keeps a renamed folder's old names as aliases, but they don't match here.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the folder.
- `display_extension` (String) Display name of the folder itself, shown in the Grouper UI.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the folder and its parents, separated by colons.
- `id` (String) UUID of the folder.
